stdout:
usage: receipt_calculator.py [-h] --item NAME QUANTITY UNIT_PRICE UNIT

Calculate an offline receipt in Indonesian rupiah using exact decimal
arithmetic.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --item NAME QUANTITY UNIT_PRICE UNIT
                        add one product; UNIT is a nonblank label such as kg
                        or each

Repeat --item for each product. Use plain decimals without Rp, commas, or
exponent notation; up to 18 integer and 12 fractional digits per
quantity/price. Zero is accepted. Quote names/units containing spaces.
Example: --item rice 2 30000 kg --item onions 1 43000 kg
